query: From which date will examples of MediShield Life premiums computation be provided without Phased Support?
context:
[Document 1]
Older Pioneer Generation seniors with serious pre-existing conditions receive additional MediSave top-ups of $50 to $200 annually from 2021 to 2025, which can be used to pay MediShield Life premiums.

[Document 2]
The Central Provident Fund (CPF) Board administers the MediShield Life Scheme under the provisions of the MediShield Life Scheme Act 2015.

[Document 3]
The claimable amount is $1,000 and it is less than the deductible of $2,000, so there is no payout from MediShield Life.

[Document 4]
The deductible under MediShield Life ranges from $2,000 to $4,500, depending on the claimant's age and choice of ward class.

[Document 5]
The information in the MediShield Life Scheme booklet is correct as of 1 April 2025.
answer: [Document 1] provides that examples of MediShield Life premiums computation will be provided without Phased Support from 2026 onwards. [Document 5] states the information is up to date as of 1 April 2025, indicating this change occurred after that date.
